# PSEUDOMONAS AERUGINOSA INFECTIONS IN BONE OR JOINT PROSTHESES

For acute, moderate or severe infections, treat with intravenous antibiotics

followed by oral antibiotics. Mild infections can be treated with oral

antibiotics only.

Consult Infectious Diseases for specific management advice.

# Duration of Treatment

Treat for a total duration of 4-6 weeks. Chronic oral antimicrobial suppression

may follow treatment based on individual patient circumstances.

# Intravenous Treatment

Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.

# Oral Treatment For Mild Infections, For Continuation of Therapy

[Ciprofloxacin 750 mg PO BID \($\) R,DI](psozid-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-ciprofloxacin-750mg-po-bid)

# Oral Treatment for Chronic Suppression

[Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO BID \($\) R,DI](psozid-ciprofl-500mg-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-ciprofl-500mg-po-bid)
